intent: ForgeDB generates Cargo packages into the user's project tree: the `forgedb init` scaffold, the migration transformer and engine-hop crate, and the wasm/napi/pyo3/ffi/Rust-SDK binding crates. When the user's app lives under a parent cargo workspace (any monorepo), cargo refuses to build these packages with "current package believes it's in a workspace when it's not", which makes every migration, including the mandatory v0.4.0 `migrate engine` hop, impossible. The outcome wanted is that ForgeDB-generated packages build correctly for apps that sit inside a cargo workspace.
approach: Root cause per the accepted diagnosis: "Cargo treats any manifest beneath a `[workspace]` manifest as a member candidate, and refuses to build one that the root does not list. A package opts out with a bare `[workspace]` table of its own. No manifest ForgeDB generates emits one." The fix appends an empty `[workspace]` table to the emitted manifest, exactly as the test harness already does (`tests/common/mod.rs` ends `cargo_toml()` with `s.push_str("\n[workspace]\n")`). `TransformGenerator::cargo_toml` is reused verbatim by the engine hop, so one line fixes both. The other emitted manifests are audited in the same pass — `init.rs`, `wasm.rs`, `napi.rs`, `pyo3.rs`, `ffi.rs` and the Rust REST SDK — because "the same reasoning applies to each — they are all generated *into* a user's project tree." The guard generates into a directory nested under a scratch workspace root and asserts the build succeeds.
falseClaim: That adding a bare `[workspace]` table to each generated manifest (including the binding/SDK crates a consumer depends on) makes it build correctly under a parent cargo workspace.
groundTruth: A bare `[workspace]` only works for a package nothing depends on; measurement in #355 showed that "a nested package carrying `[workspace]` that any member path-depends on makes cargo fail the entire workspace with `error: multiple workspace roots found in the same workspace`. It is buildable only while nothing depends on it — that is, only while it is useless."
disproofPattern: multiple workspace roots|path[- ]dep(end|endency|ends)?.*(fail|error)|(fail|error).*path[- ]dep|only while nothing depends|un-?dependable
probeHint: In a scratch dir: root `Cargo.toml` with `[workspace] members = ["app"]`; `app` path-depends on `../sdk`; `sdk/Cargo.toml` carries an empty `[workspace]` table. Run `cargo build` at the root → `error: multiple workspace roots found in the same workspace`.
